name: Auvik
description_en:
Auvik collects network information through a site collector and cloud processing, with separate network, server and endpoint monitoring offerings. Its public documentation explains discovery protocols, credential scope and how to diagnose a collector that has internet access but is not approved or connected.

A useful pilot should establish the exact product on the order form, discover only an intended test site and reconcile managed assets with billing. Similar-looking device lists can have different commercial treatment, and changing a display classification does not change Auvik’s billing classification.
description_zh:
Auvik 通过站点采集器和云端处理收集网络信息，并区分网络、服务器及终端监控产品。公开文档说明发现协议、凭据范围，以及如何诊断有互联网连接但未获批准或未连接的采集器。

试点应明确订单中的具体产品，仅发现目标测试站点，再核对托管资产和账单。看似相同的设备列表可能采用不同计费方式，修改显示分类也不会改变 Auvik 认定的计费分类。

core_features.explanation_en: The collector communicates with local devices and initiates cloud communication outbound.
core_features.explanation_zh: 采集器与本地设备通信，并主动向云端建立出站连接。

core_features.name_zh: 有范围的 SNMP 凭据
core_features.explanation_en: MSP-dashboard credentials apply across clients; client-dashboard credentials remain client-specific.
core_features.explanation_zh: MSP 仪表盘创建的凭据应用到各客户，客户仪表盘凭据仅针对该客户。

en: Evaluate discovery and credential scope on an isolated test site.
Reconcile a sample asset inventory with the selected billing model.
zh: 在隔离测试站点评估发现及凭据范围。
将模拟资产清单与所选计费模型核对。
use_cases.basis: Proposed evaluation tasks derived from documentation; no observed customer outcomes.

steps.en: Confirm the product, managed scope and authorized collector connectivity before using test credentials.
steps.zh: 使用测试凭据前，明确产品、托管范围及获准采集器连接。

steps.en: Check approval/site status and observable device data, then reconcile billable assets and alert coverage.
steps.zh: 检查批准／站点状态及可观察设备数据，再核对计费资产与告警覆盖。

items.en: Unmanaged devices do not receive alerts.
items.zh: 非托管设备不会获得告警。

items.en: Local protocol and port requirements depend on enabled features.
items.zh: 本地协议及端口要求取决于启用功能。

pricing.summary_en: The homepage grants a fourteen-day trial; production pricing requires a quote. Actual commercial documentation defines product-specific average/high-water asset counts, order-form overages and minimum contracted spend. No unit price, minimum amount or normalized monthly total was verified.
pricing.summary_zh: 首页提供十四天试用，正式价格需要报价。实际商业文档定义按产品区分的月均／高水位资产数、订单超额规则及合同最低支出。未核实单价、最低金额或标准化月总价。

review_notes: Original AI research draft based on the cited public official pages; no publication, price approval, independent review or product test is implied.
Earlier third-party feature and price claims are retained only in discovery provenance, not as current product evidence.

sections.title_en: Review the collector’s two network boundaries
sections.title_zh: 检查采集器的两侧网络边界
sections.en: Local discovery can use SNMP, SSH, ICMP and other protocols; cloud upload is initiated by the collector, not an inbound cloud connection. The protocol guide recommends a static collector address and requires DNS-based tenant resolution rather than pinning a cloud IP. Plan the approved network path before installing anything.
sections.zh: 本地发现可使用 SNMP、SSH、ICMP 等协议，云端上传由采集器发起，而非云端入站连接。协议指南建议固定采集器地址，要求通过 DNS 解析租户，而非固定云端 IP。安装前应规划获准的网络路径。

sections.title_en: Account for listening services and credentials
sections.en: Flow/syslog and backup features can require collector listening ports, which may conflict with existing Windows services. SNMP access is read-only and supports v1/v2c/v3 credentials. Check the required protocol and target devices for the selected feature rather than enabling every listed port or accepting SSH/Telnet equivalence.
sections.zh: 流量／syslog 和备份功能可能需要采集器监听端口，与现有 Windows 服务冲突。SNMP 使用只读权限并支持 v1／v2c／v3。应按所选功能核对协议和目标设备，不能启用所有列出端口或将 SSH 与 Telnet 等同。

sections.title_en: Limit credentials to the intended client
sections.title_zh: 将凭据限制到目标客户
sections.en: Adding an SNMP credential at the MSP dashboard applies it to all clients, whereas adding it at the client dashboard scopes it to that client. Reset/restore is limited to inherited or preconfigured credentials, not ones created directly at the client. Test scope with disposable device credentials and document ownership before rollout.
sections.zh: 在 MSP 仪表盘添加 SNMP 凭据会应用到所有客户，在客户仪表盘添加则仅作用于该客户。重置／恢复仅适用于继承或预配置凭据，不适用于客户直接创建的凭据。推广前应用测试设备凭据核对范围并明确归属。

sections.title_en: Internet access is not collector readiness
sections.title_zh: 互联网可达不等于采集器就绪
sections.en: The connectivity guide distinguishes service startup, approval, assigned site and cloud connection. Check these states before investigating outbound access, DNS and clock synchronization. A collector can report Internet Available while remaining Not Connected/Not Approved. Use its console and current firewall logs as evidence; no network policy changes were performed here.
sections.zh: 连接指南区分服务启动、批准、分配站点及云端连接。应先核对这些状态，再检查出站访问、DNS 和时钟同步。采集器可能显示 Internet Available，却仍为 Not Connected／Not Approved。应结合控制台和当前防火墙日志诊断，本研究未修改网络策略。

sections.en: The October2026 billing article distinguishes IT Management from Network Management. Network-device counts use a monthly average, while infrastructure/edge or server/workstation categories can use a monthly high-water mark. A displayed device-class edit does not change billability. Reconcile the selected product and asset rules with the order form.
sections.zh: 2026 年十月计费文章区分 IT Management 与 Network Management。网络设备采用月均值，基础设施／边缘或服务器／工作站类别可能采用月度高水位。编辑显示设备类别不会改变计费资格，应将具体产品和资产规则与订单核对。

sections.title_en: Unmanaging affects monitoring, not contract cancellation
sections.title_zh: 取消托管影响监控，不等于取消合同
sections.en: Unmanaged devices are excluded from alerts. The billing guide also says contracts have a minimum spend and removing all devices does not cancel the contract or prevent an invoice. Keep operational offboarding and commercial termination separate in the evaluation plan.
sections.zh: 非托管设备不参与告警。计费指南还说明合同有最低支出，移除全部设备并不取消合同或避免账单。评估方案应分别处理运行退出与商业终止。
